import ctypes
import numpy as np
from numpy.ctypeslib import ndpointer

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define GSL matrix structure
class gsl_matrix_complex(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size1", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("size2", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("tda", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("block", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("owner", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_linalg_complex_QR_decomp_r(gsl_matrix_complex * A, gsl_matrix_complex * T)
gsl.gsl_linalg_complex_QR_decomp_r.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix_complex)]
gsl.gsl_linalg_complex_QR_decomp_r.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Helper function to create GSL matrix from numpy array
def create_gsl_matrix_complex(np_array):
    rows, cols = np_array.shape
    matrix = gsl_matrix_complex()
    matrix.size1 = rows
    matrix.size2 = cols
    matrix.tda = cols
    matrix.data = np_array.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p))
    matrix.block = None
    matrix.owner = 1
    return matrix

# Define the function to perform QR decomposition
def complex_qr_decomp(A, T):
    if A.shape[0] != T.shape[0] or T.shape[0] != T.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError("Matrix T must be square and match the row dimensions of A.")
    A = np.ascontiguousarray(A, dtype=np.complex128)
    T = np.ascontiguousarray(T, dtype=np.complex128)
    gsl_A = create_gsl_matrix_complex(A)
    gsl_T = create_gsl_matrix_complex(T)
    status = gsl.gsl_linalg_complex_QR_decomp_r(ctypes.byref(gsl_A), ctypes.byref(gsl_T))
    return status

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Simple 2x2 matrix
    A = np.array([[1+1j, 2+2j], [3+3j, 4+4j]], dtype=np.complex128)
    T = np.zeros((2, 2), dtype=np.complex128)
    status = complex_qr_decomp(A, T)
    assert status == 0, "Test case 1 failed"

    # Test case 2: 3x3 matrix
    A = np.array([[1+1j, 2+2j, 3+3j], [4+4j, 5+5j, 6+6j], [7+7j, 8+8j, 9+9j]], dtype=np.complex128)
    T = np.zeros((3, 3), dtype=np.complex128)
    status = complex_qr_decomp(A, T)
    assert status == 0, "Test case 2 failed"

    # Test case 3: Error case, T not square
    try:
        A = np.array([[1+1j, 2+2j], [3+3j, 4+4j]], dtype=np.complex128)
        T = np.zeros((2, 3), dtype=np.complex128)  # Incorrect dimensions
        status = complex_qr_decomp(A, T)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == "Matrix T must be square and match the row dimensions of A.", "Test case 3 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
